dynamic_cases: symlinked scan input under sources/ blocks a rights-ready ledger without reading through the link
local LICENSE target that is itself a symlink blocks even when it resolves inside the archive
HTML href, reStructuredText inline link, and reStructuredText reference definitions pointing at missing rights files are checked
in-document #license anchors are ignored rather than misclassified as missing local files
limits: The scan still checks local rights-reference integrity only; it does not determine license compatibility or legal sufficiency.
The partial overlay does not contain the full canonical sources/papers tree, so its ledger-count comparison intentionally fails closed.
purpose: Fail closed when publication-critical rights-reference scans encounter symlinked scan inputs, symlinked local rights targets, or additional common local rights link forms.
risk_reduced: A later rights-ready ledger cannot publish through a fresh scan that reads host/cloudtainer symlink targets or accepts LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE references that resolve through symlinks; HTML and reStructuredText local rights references are checked too.
